title: Underground auxiliary ventilation fan, blade crack
tests: Thin notes; safety-critical; natural vs forced unclear (resonance on VSD?).
summary: A crack was found at the root of a blade on an underground auxiliary fan during a routine inspection. Notes are very short. Cause could be fatigue (natural), resonance on the VSD, or impeller damage. The AI should ask questions, not conclude.

problem.title: Blade root crack on auxiliary ventilation fan VF-14
problem.whatHappened: A crack about 80 mm long was found at the root of one blade on VF-14 at the 6-monthly inspection. Fan taken out of service.
problem.impact: Heading ventilation lost until a spare fan was installed.

evidence.title: Blade root crack
evidence.note: Crack along the weld toe on one blade; other blades not crack-tested.

tree.text: Blade root crack on auxiliary ventilation fan VF-14

actions.description: Replace the fan with the spare

mustSuggest.idea: Vibration or resonance at an operating speed on the VSD
Weld quality or repair history of the impeller
Fan inspection includes no dye penetrant or vibration check of all blades
Inspection findings: a past repair or overspeed event may not be recorded

acceptable: Operating speed above the design speed
wrongOrDangerous: Anything stating the fan was overloaded

mustFlag.note: Flagged root has only a corrective action

challenge.expectation: Questions: speed history, imbalance, weld repair history, inspection of other blades. Safety noted: heading ventilation is a safety function; site process first.
deliberateWeaknesses: Natural fatigue vs forced (resonance, imbalance, overspeed) not decided
The only cause is flagged as root, a hypothesis with no preventive action

capa.deteriorationReasoning: A blade root crack might be fatigue at the end of life or caused by resonance, imbalance or weld defects. Check the vibration history, speed range and weld records to decide.

preventive.what: Crack test (dye penetrant or similar) on all blades and welds on the fans in service
Vibration check across the VSD speed range for resonance
Record impeller repair and overspeed events against the fan
Hold a spare impeller and a spare fan, for safety-critical ventilation

capa.spares: One spare fan and an impeller; a fan was in stock.
capa.rollout: All auxiliary fans of the same make and VSD set-up: crack test and run a speed sweep.
unacceptable: Invent hours run or design life

mustInclude: crack about 80 mm at the root of one blade found on the 6-monthly inspection
gapsToPointOut: What speed has the fan been running at?
When was the fan last repaired?
How long was the heading without ventilation?
